detail: Full summary: the spec's ratify queue has no exit condition — DecisionStatus has no ratified state and approving leaves a decision active+irreversible, in queue forever; the repo already ships the ratification state machine (twining_reconsider active→provisional, twining_promote provisional→active) which the spec inverts and omits from its §9 tool list
